sourceTool: OMP GenerateImage tool, openai-codex/gpt-5.5 image provider
prompt: Generate ONLY the background artwork for a 1536x720 wide website header; no UI, no words, no logos. Use assets/references/hero-composition-reference.png as the composition and mood reference. Preserve a clean title-safe rectangle from x=260..1280 and y=0..230: pale parchment sky with only soft clouds and haze, no tree leaves, branches, birds, mountains, buildings, castle silhouettes, high-contrast edges, or spires inside that rectangle. On the right ridge, outside the title-safe rectangle, build a larger distant castle city with 3-5 distinct tall spires of varied heights; the tallest spire must be clearly the tallest element on the right side. These towers may rise into the right-side sky in x=1300..1536 and y=120..400, but must not cross into x=260..1280 and y=0..230. Keep the castle mass on the right third, starting around x=1130 and y=190 or lower, below and beside where the title will sit. Frame the low-left sun through a visible left tree trunk and crown, with winding paths, a sparkling river, a small hamlet, farms, and a bridge receding through the lower half of the valley below y=250. Keep the bottom edge detailed but naturally fade-friendly for a CSS mask. Palette: parchment cream sky, honey-gold sunlight, olive greens, muted teal shadows, soft brown stone. Feeling: inviting, friendly, alive, full of exploration and discovery. Avoid gloomy darkness, hard black vignette, empty wasteland, title-zone clutter, or any words/logos/UI.
reviewNotes: Regenerated against assets/references/hero-composition-reference.png to address the missing verticality in the previous right-side city: the castle ridge now has several taller spires concentrated in the far-right sky while the upper-center title-safe area remains open. The reference continues to define the inviting, friendly, alive direction (warm parchment sky, honey-gold sunlight, olive greens, muted teal shadows) and the safe layout (visible left tree crown and trunk, low sun, winding paths, river, hamlet, farms, bridge, and a right-third castle city). assets/references/page-early-draft.png is kept as a historical earlier exploration. The committed derivative is a wide 1536x720 header crop so the page does not rely on browser-cropping a tall painting. The asset is decorative; page text and controls remain real HTML.

composition.titleSafeZone: upper center stays open; castle, tree, and mountains do not overlap the h1/lede area
requiredElements: visible left tree crown and trunk framing the sun
winding river and paths receding through the valley
small hamlet and farms in the midground
castle on the right third, below and beside the title safe area
3-5 distinct tall castle spires of varied heights on the right ridge
negativeConstraints: no castle silhouette behind or touching the page title
no tree canopy crossing the page title
no right-side towers crossing into the title safe rectangle
no hard downward image cut before the category grid
no opaque top header at initial scroll position
no gloomy dark vignette over the primary first impression

upscalingNotes: The committed source is 1536x720 and is not AI-upscaled. For production, prefer a native 2x-or-larger wide generation or a faithful upscaler such as Topaz/Gigapixel or Recraft Crisp Upscale before final WebP/AVIF export; avoid creative/generative upscaling unless explicitly accepting invented detail.
